00-spec.yaml invariant states Fase A introduces no inbound network, but crates/hexcell/src/salud.rs already binds a loopback HTTP server serving /health/live and /health/ready, exercised by crates/hexcell/tests/salud_http.rs. The invariant is read as forbidding a NEW endpoint rather than asserting no listener exists. Recorded as a blueprint RISK; 00-spec.yaml was not rewritten.

The orchestrator bundle assumed hexcell-admin is a CLI that opens the cell DB read-only. It is a 10-line stub with an empty [dependencies] table and no argument parsing, whose doc comment defers the CLI-library choice until the subcommands are known. It reads no data, and an out-of-process CLI could not satisfy AC-3 (live semaphore gauge) in any case. The hexcell-admin exposure option was therefore rejected and the crate left in forbid.files.

Exposure mechanism: periodic structured-log snapshot (event metricas_instantanea), rejecting an HTTP /metrics endpoint on the existing health server, a hexcell-admin subcommand, and a metrics table in sessions.db. Rationale: zero new surface, no hot-path writes to the single-writer WAL on the i7/8GB target, and it is the remedy shape named by docs/STATUS.md finding 9 and the design direction at docs/STATUS.md line 517 (operator visibility via structured-log aggregation). Counters are process-local AtomicU64 reset on restart. Deviation formula: sum(monto_reservado) - sum(unidades_consumidas) over conciliated reservations, computed as SUM(movimientos.monto) WHERE clase = 'conciliacion'. New module crates/hexcell/src/metricas.rs; motor.rs is touched additively only.
